description: Returns the text of one article of Book 1 of the Belgian AREI/RGIE by its number (for example 4.2.4.3 or "AREI 7.1.4.3"), in the language of the text (Dutch, French or German; English uses the German text), with the edition, change notices of amending decrees, the titles of its sub-articles and a link to the article in the PlanElec reader. Cite the article number and edition when you pass the content on. Use search_regelwerk to find the number.

article.description: Article number such as 4.2.4.3; a prefix such as "AREI" or "RGIE" is accepted.

locale.description: Language of source titles and links (nl, fr, de, en). Defaults to the server setting.

version.description: Optional edition, e.g. v06 or v07. Default: the edition in force today (v06 until 31/10/2026, v07 from 01/11/2026).

name: get_regelwerk_article
title: Read an AREI/RGIE article
